title: Radiology & Medical Imaging
blurb: Chest X-ray, CT, MRI, mammography, ultrasound and echocardiography collections, many with labels or segmentations.

items.name: MIMIC-CXR
items.description: 377,110 chest radiographs (DICOM) with 227,835 free-text radiology reports from BIDMC, linkable to MIMIC-IV. A JPG version with NLP-derived labels (MIMIC-CXR-JPG) is also available.

paper.label: Johnson AEW et al. Sci Data 2019;6:317

items.name: CheXpert
items.description: 224,316 chest radiographs of 65,240 Stanford patients labelled for 14 observations with uncertainty labels; the basis of a well-known benchmark.
items.access_note: Free registration and acceptance of the Stanford research-use agreement.

paper.label: Irvin J et al. AAAI 2019;33:590

items.name: NIH ChestX-ray14
items.description: 112,120 frontal chest X-rays from 30,805 patients at the NIH Clinical Center with 14 text-mined disease labels and some bounding boxes.

paper.label: Wang X et al. CVPR 2017

items.name: PadChest
items.description: 160,000+ chest X-rays from Hospital San Juan (Spain) with Spanish reports and 174 radiographic findings, 27% manually annotated by radiologists.
items.access_note: Free; request form and research-use agreement.

paper.label: Bustos A et al. Med Image Anal 2020;66:101797

items.name: VinDr-CXR
items.description: 18,000 chest X-rays from two Vietnamese hospitals with radiologist bounding-box annotations for 22 local findings and 6 global diagnoses.

paper.label: Nguyen HQ et al. Sci Data 2022;9:429

items.name: VinDr-Mammo
items.description: 5,000 four-view full-field digital mammography exams with BI-RADS, density and finding-level annotations from Vietnamese hospitals.
items.access_note: Free PhysioNet account + signed data use agreement (no credentialing needed).

paper.label: Nguyen HT et al. Sci Data 2023;10:277

items.name: RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge
items.description: ~30,000 chest X-rays (from NIH ChestX-ray14) re-annotated by radiologists with bounding boxes for lung opacity suggestive of pneumonia.
items.access_note: Free Kaggle account and acceptance of competition rules.

paper.label: Shih G et al. Radiol Artif Intell 2019;1:e180041

items.name: The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA)
items.description: Large archive of de-identified cancer imaging collections (CT, MRI, PET, pathology) — e.g. LIDC-IDRI, CBIS-DDSM, NLST — often linked to TCGA genomics and clinical data.
items.provider: US National Cancer Institute / University of Arkansas
items.access_note: Most collections open (CC BY); some limited-access collections require a signed agreement.

paper.label: Clark K et al. J Digit Imaging 2013;26:1045

items.name: LIDC-IDRI
items.description: 1,018 thoracic CT scans with lung-nodule annotations by four radiologists — the standard dataset for lung-nodule detection (LUNA16 derives from it).

paper.label: Armato SG et al. Med Phys 2011;38:915

items.name: CBIS-DDSM
items.description: Curated, DICOM-converted subset of the Digital Database for Screening Mammography with updated ROI segmentations and pathology-verified labels.

paper.label: Lee RS et al. Sci Data 2017;4:170177

items.name: EMBED
items.description: 3.4 million screening and diagnostic mammograms from 116,000 racially diverse women with BI-RADS, pathology and demographic data.
items.access_note: Free for research; data-use agreement and AWS access request.

paper.label: Jeong JJ et al. Radiol Artif Intell 2023;5:e220047

items.name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon
items.description: Ten 3D segmentation tasks (brain tumour, heart, liver, hippocampus, prostate, lung, pancreas, hepatic vessels, spleen, colon) for benchmarking generalisable algorithms.

paper.label: Antonelli M et al. Nat Commun 2022;13:4128

items.name: TotalSegmentator dataset
items.description: 1,228 CT scans with segmentations of 117 anatomical structures (organs, bones, muscles, vessels), released alongside the popular TotalSegmentator tool.

paper.label: Wasserthal J et al. Radiol Artif Intell 2023;5:e230024

items.name: KiTS
items.description: Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT scans with expert segmentations of kidneys, tumours and cysts (KiTS19/21/23).

paper.label: Heller N et al. Med Image Anal 2021;67:101821

items.name: LiTS
items.description: 131 training and 70 test contrast-enhanced abdominal CT scans with liver and tumour segmentations from seven institutions.

paper.label: Bilic P et al. Med Image Anal 2023;84:102680

items.name: LUNA16
items.description: 888 CT scans from LIDC-IDRI with standardised nodule annotations and an evaluation framework for nodule detection.
items.access_note: Free Grand Challenge account; data also on Zenodo.

paper.label: Setio AAA et al. Med Image Anal 2017;42:1

items.name: fastMRI
items.description: Raw k-space and DICOM data for knee, brain, prostate and breast MRI from NYU Langone, built for accelerated MRI reconstruction research.
items.access_note: Free; submit a short form and accept the data sharing agreement to receive download links.

paper.label: Knoll F et al. Radiol Artif Intell 2020;2:e190007

items.name: EchoNet-Dynamic
items.description: 10,030 apical four-chamber echocardiography videos with expert tracings, ejection fraction and volumes from Stanford Medicine.
items.access_note: Free registration and research-use agreement (Stanford AIMI).

paper.label: Ouyang D et al. Nature 2020;580:252

items.name: CAMUS
items.description: 2D echocardiographic sequences from 500 patients with expert segmentations of left ventricle, myocardium and left atrium.

paper.label: Leclerc S et al. IEEE Trans Med Imaging 2019;38:2198

items.name: ACDC
items.description: Cine cardiac MRI from 150 patients across five diagnostic groups with ventricular and myocardial segmentations.

paper.label: Bernard O et al. IEEE Trans Med Imaging 2018;37:2514

items.name: BUSI
items.description: 780 breast ultrasound images from 600 women in Egypt, labelled normal, benign or malignant with ground-truth masks.

paper.label: Al-Dhabyani W et al. Data Brief 2020;28:104863

items.name: Kermany OCT & Paediatric Chest X-ray
items.description: 108,000+ labelled retinal OCT images (CNV, DME, drusen, normal) and 5,800 paediatric chest X-rays (pneumonia vs normal) from the landmark Cell transfer-learning paper.
items.provider: UC San Diego / Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center
items.access_note: Direct download from Mendeley Data (CC BY 4.0).

paper.label: Kermany DS et al. Cell 2018;172:1122

items.name: MURA
items.description: 40,561 musculoskeletal radiographs of the upper extremity from 12,173 patients labelled normal/abnormal by radiologists.

paper.label: Rajpurkar P et al. arXiv 2017

items.name: Stanford AIMI Shared Datasets
items.description: Portal hosting many Stanford imaging datasets free for research: CheXpert, EchoNet, DDI, CT colonography, knee MRI, BrainMetShare and more.
items.provider: Stanford Center for AI in Medicine & Imaging
items.access_note: Free registration and Stanford research-use agreement per dataset.

items.name: Open-i (incl. IU X-ray)
items.description: NLM search engine over 3.7 million images from PubMed Central articles plus the Indiana University chest X-ray collection (7,470 images with reports).
items.access_note: Open web and API; IU X-ray downloadable.

paper.label: Demner-Fushman D et al. JAMIA 2016;23:304

items.name: MedMNIST v2
items.description: 18 standardised, lightweight 2D and 3D biomedical image datasets (pathology, chest X-ray, dermatology, retina, CT organs…) in MNIST-like format for fast prototyping and teaching.
items.access_note: pip install medmnist or download from Zenodo (CC BY).

paper.label: Yang J et al. Sci Data 2023;10:41

items.name: COVIDx
items.description: Open benchmark of tens of thousands of chest X-rays and CT scans assembled from multiple public sources for COVID-19 detection (COVID-Net).

paper.label: Wang L et al. Sci Rep 2020;10:19549

items.name: BIMCV-COVID19+
items.description: Chest X-ray and CT studies of COVID-19 patients from the Valencian region with radiological findings, reports and lab results.

items.name: MedPix
items.description: Free open-access database of ~59,000 medical images and ~12,000 teaching cases indexed by diagnosis, organ system and modality.

items.name: MIDRC
items.full_name: Medical Imaging and Data Resource Center
items.description: Open commons of 500,000+ de-identified imaging studies (chest X-ray, CT, MRI) with clinical data, initially built for COVID-19.
items.access_note: Free login and data use agreement in the MIDRC data commons.

items.name: Duke-CSpineSeg
items.description: 1,255 cervical spine MRI exams with vertebra and disc segmentations from Duke University Health System.

items.name: Duke Breast Cancer MRI
items.description: Pre-operative dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI of 922 invasive breast cancer patients with imaging features, pathology and outcomes.

paper.label: Saha A et al. Br J Cancer 2018;119:508

items.name: MAMA-MIA
items.description: 1,506 breast DCE-MRI cases from four TCIA collections with expert tumour segmentations and harmonised clinical data.

items.name: RSNA Screening Mammography
items.description: Enriched screening mammography set with cancers, biopsy-proven benign findings and negatives, released after the RSNA breast-cancer-detection challenge.

items.name: RSNA Intracranial Hemorrhage Detection
items.description: ~874,000 head CT slices from 25,000 exams annotated by neuroradiologists for five haemorrhage subtypes.
items.access_note: Free Kaggle account and acceptance of competition rules.

paper.label: Flanders AE et al. Radiol Artif Intell 2020;2:e190211

items.name: RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection
items.description: Knee MRI studies labelled for twelve abnormal findings from the RSNA challenge.
items.access_note: Free Kaggle account and acceptance of competition rules.

items.name: RICORD
items.full_name: RSNA International COVID-19 Open Radiology Database
items.description: Expert-annotated chest CT (240 studies) and chest radiographs (1,000) of COVID-19 from multiple institutions.

paper.label: Tsai EB et al. Radiology 2021;299:E204

items.name: CT-ICH
items.description: 82 head CT scans of traumatic brain injury patients with intracranial haemorrhage segmentations.
items.access_note: Free PhysioNet account + signed data use agreement.

paper.label: Hssayeni MD et al. Data 2020;5:14

items.name: SinoCT
items.description: 9,000+ non-contrast head CT scans labelled normal or abnormal (~1.3 TB) from Chinese hospitals.
items.access_note: Free registration and Stanford research-use agreement.

items.name: NIH DeepLesion
items.description: 32,000+ annotated lesions on 10,594 CT studies of 4,427 patients, mined from radiologist bookmarks at the NIH Clinical Center.

paper.label: Yan K et al. J Med Imaging 2018;5:036501

items.name: AbdomenAtlas
items.description: Large-scale multi-organ annotations on thousands of abdominal CT volumes (AbdomenAtlas-8K and later releases) produced with AI-assisted expert review.

paper.label: Qu C et al. NeurIPS 2023 Datasets & Benchmarks

items.name: MICCAI FLARE Pan-cancer CT
items.description: 17,000+ CT scans with pan-cancer lesion labels from the FLARE challenge for foundation-model segmentation.
items.access_note: Hugging Face account and acceptance of terms (gated).

items.name: ReXGroundingCT
items.description: Chest CT volumes with free-text findings linked to pixel-level 3D segmentations for grounded report generation.
items.access_note: Hugging Face account and acceptance of terms (gated).

items.name: RAD-ChestCT
items.description: Initial public release of 3,630 chest CT volumes from Duke with 83 abnormality labels extracted from reports.

paper.label: Draelos RL et al. Med Image Anal 2021;67:101857

items.name: MR-RATE
items.description: Brain and spine MRI volumes paired with radiology reports for vision-language modelling.
items.access_note: Hugging Face account and acceptance of terms (gated).

items.name: CirrMRI600+
items.description: 628 T1- and T2-weighted abdominal MRI scans of cirrhotic livers with expert segmentations.

items.name: BRAX
items.description: 40,967 chest X-rays from Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, São Paulo, labelled for 14 findings.

paper.label: Reis EP et al. Sci Data 2022;9:487

items.name: PadChest-GR
items.description: 4,555 bilingual (Spanish/English) chest X-ray studies with sentence-level findings grounded to bounding boxes.
items.access_note: Free; request form and research-use agreement.

items.name: CheXpert Plus
items.description: 223,462 chest X-ray–report pairs from Stanford with pathology labels, RadGraph annotations and demographics.
items.access_note: Free registration and Stanford research-use agreement.

paper.label: Chambon P et al. arXiv 2024

items.name: EchoNet-Pediatric
items.description: 7,643 paediatric echocardiogram videos with LV tracings and ejection fraction from Lucile Packard Children's Hospital.
items.access_note: Free registration and Stanford research-use agreement.

paper.label: Reddy CD et al. J Am Soc Echocardiogr 2023;36:482

items.name: EchoNet-LVH
items.description: 12,000 parasternal long-axis echo videos with wall-thickness measurements for detecting LV hypertrophy and its causes.
items.access_note: Free registration and Stanford research-use agreement.

paper.label: Duffy G et al. JAMA Cardiol 2022;7:386

items.name: M&Ms Cardiac Segmentation
items.description: 375 cine cardiac MRI studies from four scanner vendors and six centres with ventricular segmentations, for domain-generalisation research.
items.access_note: Free registration on the challenge site.

paper.label: Campello VM et al. IEEE Trans Med Imaging 2021;40:3543

items.name: OpenPOCUS Lung Ultrasound
items.description: Point-of-care lung ultrasound clips (300,000+ frames) from 226 emergency department patients with labels.

items.name: MedShapeNet
items.description: 100,000+ 3D medical shapes (organs, bones, vessels, instruments) extracted from public segmentation datasets.
items.provider: Institute for AI in Medicine, Essen

paper.label: Li J et al. arXiv 2023

items.name: MedPix 2.0
items.description: Structured version of NLM MedPix CT and MRI cases with clinical notes, built for multimodal model training.

items.name: Nightingale Open Science
items.description: Non-profit platform of curated, outcome-linked medical datasets (ECG waveforms, biopsy slides, chest X-rays) from health systems worldwide.
items.access_note: Free; register and apply; analysis in a secure cloud.
